description: This file contains the implementation of RPC proxy and stub stubs for the ISystemAudioPlayer and its nested INotification interface, part of the ProxyStubs namespace within the WPEFramework. It defines method handlers for remote procedure calls and proxies for the ISystemAudioPlayer interface and its notification system, enabling inter-process communication for system audio player controls.

classes.name: SystemAudioPlayerProxy
classes.description: Proxy class implementing the ISystemAudioPlayer interface for RPC communication. It provides methods to invoke remote procedures such as Configure, Register, Unregister, Open, Play, etc.

classes.name: SystemAudioPlayerNotificationProxy
classes.description: Proxy class implementing the INotification interface to receive events such as OnSAPEvents from the remote system.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Invokes the remote Configure method with an IShell pointer.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback with the remote system.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification callback from the remote system.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the specified input with the remote system and retrieves output.

methods.name: Play
methods.description: Starts playback of the specified input.

methods.name: PlayBuffer
methods.description: Plays buffer data provided in the input.

methods.name: Pause
methods.description: Pauses playback of the specified input.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Resumes playback of the specified input.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops playback of the specified input.

methods.name: SetMixerLevels
methods.description: Sets the mixer levels based on input parameters.

methods.name: IsPlaying
methods.description: Checks if the specified input is currently playing.

methods.name: Config
methods.description: Retrieves or sets configuration related to the input.

methods.name: GetPlayerSessionId
methods.description: Retrieves the session ID associated with a player for the given input.

methods.name: OnSAPEvents
methods.description: Notification callback invoked when SAP events occur.
